newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details primary elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in primary elevators across the Prairies tightened up slightly in the past week, the Canadian Wheat Board said.

About 27 percent of space was available in primary elevators across the Prairies in the past week with Alberta unchanged from the previous week at 37 percent, Saskatchewan unchanged at 24 percent but Manitoba tighter at 18 percent compared to 20 percent the week before, the CWB said.
Railcar unloads at export terminals in the week of November 25 to December 1 did not meet targets, the CWB said.
Unloads at Vancouver were 2,470, below the 3,400 target.
Unloads at Prince Rupert totalled 1,017, beneath the 1,500 target.
Unloads at Thunder Bay reached 1,964, below the 3,300 target.
